title: The Cost of Link-Only Culture
author: RN Collins
principle: Evidence leads; atmosphere never substitutes for provenance.

narrativeSequence.caption: Link-only publication can respect rights, but a culture whose evidence lives only behind unstable links inherits broken memory, platform power, and unequal access.
The frame is not neutral delivery: pose, setting, crop, light, garment, commission, and publication context combine to manufacture a public fashion meaning.
narrativeSequence.rights: Free to Use and Reuse / Library of Congress curated set

narrativeSequence.caption: 01 · DEPEND — Which memory exists only elsewhere?. Inventory source URL, platform, account owner, identifier, format, access condition, geography, login, cost, rights, and evidence use.
narrativeSequence.rights: Original publication graphic; no third-party imagery

narrativeSequence.caption: 02 · PERMIT — What may lawfully be retained?. Separate public visibility, download ability, license, authorized embed, preservation copy, quotation, metadata, and link. Review contracts and jurisdiction where uncertain.
narrativeSequence.rights: Original publication graphic; no third-party imagery

narrativeSequence.caption: 03 · DESCRIBE — What survives without the media?. Write a faithful factual description, creator and institution credit, date, identifier, evidentiary relevance, rights status, and retrieval history without substituting invented imagery.
narrativeSequence.rights: Original publication graphic; no third-party imagery

narrativeSequence.caption: 04 · RECOVER — What happens after failure?. Schedule link checks, preserve redirects and replacement records, document loss, contact stewards, update citations, and keep correction history.
narrativeSequence.rights: Original publication graphic; no third-party imagery
